Maya Chen (CS): Quick capture from ClearFlow onboarding — customer asks + pains for triage.
Ethan Rivera (PM): Paste raw bullets pls.
Maya Chen (CS): Raw notes:
- Request: tenant model-freeze / pin toggle in Console during audits.
- Request: per-route cost labels + downloadable CSV for finance.
- Pain: low-volume endpoints see intermittent TTFB spikes (~300-700ms).
- Pain: private deploy logs drop X-User-ID when proxied through their sidecar.
- Ask: 30-min enablement + one-page procurement justification.
Harpreet Singh (Eng): Short tech notes: model-freeze = routing pin + RBAC; CSV exporter ~3 dev-days; warm-worker pilot to reduce TTFB ~1 week. Need traces & sidecar config.
Nora Diaz (Product): From renewal call: billing CSV + model-freeze = high priority. Enablement one-pager helps close procurement.
Ethan Rivera (PM): Prioritization proposal:
1) Cost labels + CSV -> P0 -> owner: Ethan -> ETA: 2w
2) Model-freeze toggle -> P0 -> owner: Nora -> ETA: 3w
3) Audit header passthrough spec -> P1 -> owner: Maya -> ETA: 5d
4) Warm-worker pilot -> P1 -> owner: Harpreet -> ETA: 2w pilot
ci-bot: Created ticket CF-4022: "ClearFlow billing export & model-freeze" assigned to Ethan Rivera due 2w.
Maya Chen (CS): I'll upload call recording, sample traces, and customer CSV example to /customers/clearflow/onboard and schedule enablement.
Ethan Rivera (PM): Adding smoke-test prompt set and finance CSV schema to CF-4022.
Harpreet Singh (Eng): Will start scoping warm-worker infra once traces are uploaded.
Maya Chen (CS): Thanks team — will follow up with customer after PRD lands. :thumbsup:
